name: RSiliTech Role-Based Discounts
author: RSiliTech

sections.description:
Role-Based Discounts for WooCommerce

Automatically apply different discounts to different user roles in your WooCommerce store!

Easily create wholesale pricing, VIP discounts, student discounts, employee pricing, and more – all based on user roles. No coding required, works instantly with WooCommerce.

🎯 **Perfect For:**

  • Wholesale/B2B Stores – Different prices for retailers vs consumers
  • Membership Sites – Exclusive pricing for members
  • Educational Stores – Student/teacher discounts
  • Corporate Stores – Employee discount programs
  • Loyalty Programs – Rewards for frequent customers
  • Any store needing role-based pricing

✨ **Key Features:**

✅ Role-Based Discounts – Different discounts for different user roles
✅ Easy Setup – No coding required, works in minutes
✅ Automatic Application – Discounts apply automatically at checkout
✅ WooCommerce Native – Seamless integration
✅ Mobile Responsive – Works on all devices
✅ Lightweight – Won’t slow down your store

🛠️ **How It Works (3 Simple Steps):**

  1. Install & Activate – Works instantly with WooCommerce
  2. Set Discount Rules – Assign discount percentages to user roles
  3. Watch It Work – Users automatically see their discounted prices

📋 **Example Use Cases:**

Wholesale Business:
* Retailers get 30% discount
* Distributors get 50% discount
* Regular customers pay full price

Membership Site:
* Gold members get 40% off
* Silver members get 20% off
* Free members pay full price

Educational Discounts:
* Students get 25% off
* Teachers get 30% off
* Schools get 40% bulk discount

🔧 **Technical Details:**

  • Requires: WooCommerce 4.0+
  • Compatible with: All WordPress themes
  • Performance: Lightweight, caching-friendly
  • Updates: Regularly maintained

🆓 **Free vs Pro**

Free Version Includes:
* Basic role-based percentage discounts
* Works with existing WordPress roles
* Standard support

Upgrade to Pro for:
* Fixed amount discounts
* Custom role creation
* Individual customer pricing
* Bulk/tiered pricing
* Category-specific discounts
* Priority-based rules
* Advanced display options
* Priority support
* Regular feature updates

Transform your store with intelligent, automated role-based pricing today!

Support

  • Email: pluginsupport@rsilitech.com
  • Support Forum: https://wordpress.org/support/plugin/rsilitech-simple-pricing/
sections.installation:
1. Go to Plugins → Add New in WordPress
  2. Search for “Role-Based Discounts” or “RSiliTech”
  3. Click “Install Now” and then “Activate”
  4. Navigate to WooCommerce → Role Pricing
  5. Set your first discount in 60 seconds!

Alternative Method:
1. Upload the rsilitech-simple-pricing folder to /wp-content/plugins/
2. Activate the plugin through Plugins → Installed Plugins
3. Go to WooCommerce → Role Pricing to configure discounts
sections.faq:
What does this plugin do?

This plugin allows you to set different discount percentages for different WordPress user roles in your WooCommerce store. Discounts apply automatically when users with those roles visit your store.

Do I need WooCommerce?

Yes, this plugin requires WooCommerce to function properly. It will not work without WooCommerce installed and activated.

Can I create custom roles?

The free version works with existing WordPress roles (Customer, Subscriber, etc.). Custom role creation (like “Wholesale”, “VIP”, “Student”) is available in the Pro version.

Do discounts apply automatically?

Yes! Once you set a discount percentage for a role, it automatically applies when users with that role visit your store, add to cart, and checkout.

Can I use this with coupon codes?

Yes, you can choose whether role discounts stack with coupon codes in the settings. You can enable or disable discount stacking.

Is this compatible with variable products?

Yes, the plugin works with both simple and variable WooCommerce products.

How many roles can I set discounts for?

Unlimited! You can set discounts for any WordPress user role.

Does this work on mobile devices?

Yes, the plugin is fully responsive and works on all devices – desktop, tablet, and mobile.

Is there a money-back guarantee?

Yes, we offer a 30-day money-back guarantee on the Pro version.

How do I get support?

Free version users can use the WordPress support forum. Pro users get priority email support.
